message.content: An illustration serving as a magazine cover features a large cargo ship sailing across a blue, rippled body of water. The ship’s hull is divided into a red lower section and a black upper section, with a white superstructure at the rear. A thin mast with crossbeams stands on the foredeck. The ship leaves a white wake on the water's surface. In the lower-left foreground, a person in a white shirt and dark pants stands with their back to the viewer, arms outstretched towards the vessel. At the top, the large red word "TEMPO" is centered above the slogan "ENAK DIBACA DAN PERLU." To the right, a barcode, a QR code, and small text including "10-16 JANUARI 2022" are visible. Two article titles, "Opsi Baru untuk Papua H.28" and "Korupsi Dana PEN H.64," sit above the horizon line. In the bottom-right corner, large white text reads "Gara-gara Batu Bara," followed by smaller white text: "Larangan ekspor batu bara memicu protes pengusaha. Saatnya meninggalkan energi fosil. H.74"
